scope: Native host hook activation, bounded Stop repair and guided local handoff smoke tests. Synthetic temporary projects only. This is not a frozen release performance benchmark or a cross-agent handoff test.

environment.note: Observed interpreter version is reported as tested; it does not expand the documented support guarantee.

privacy.captured_fields: Allowlisted native hook response counts, canary presence/length, task assertions, memory counters, check results and provider usage counters. Native clients used --no-session-persistence or --ephemeral.

trust.claude: Native authenticated Claude account; print mode in a fixture created and inspected by the harness. Ordinary allowed tools, without permission bypass.
trust.codex: Normal TTY folder trust; inspected generated hook commands; /hooks reviewed one exact handler then trusted the remaining inspected handlers. Eight handlers displayed active. The normal client persisted its trust decision.

natural_smoke.outcome: Task and activation passed; first consolidation remained pending because compound bookkeeping commands generated additional events. Unsupported pass evidence stayed unknown.

guided_skill_continuation.instruction_level: Explicit /remvu invocation with standalone bookkeeping commands, inline source evidence, private proposal writes and reviewed event watermark. Runtime current; shim predates the final wording update.
guided_skill_continuation.outcome: Passed: actual check passed, known failed check retained, no pending events and current private handoff.

codex.capture: exec --ephemeral --json --sandbox workspace-write; ordinary on-request approvals; model reasoning effort low

natural_smoke.outcome: Task and activation passed; compound proposal-write/update/status call left its own two events pending. Error item body was deliberately not retained.

guided_updated_skill_continuation.instruction_level: Reinitialized updated shipping skill, explicitly invoked $remvu, and requested standalone --proposal-json bookkeeping with reviewed event watermark.
guided_updated_skill_continuation.outcome: Passed: actual check passed with evidence, no pending events and current private handoff.

limitations: Initial natural smoke attempts retained pending events after agents combined bookkeeping commands; this is preserved as an observed limitation, not relabeled as success.
Guided follow-ups used explicit instructions. They establish working documented paths, not universal model compliance.
Native PreCompact, PostCompact and Interrupt behavior was not exercised. Windows and Linux hosts were not exercised.
Codex emitted a nonfatal error item and stderr in both runs. Their bodies were excluded by the capture allowlist; the report does not claim error-free bootstrap.
Usage counters are raw platform-reported values, including cache counters. They are not compared across clients and establish no cost or token reduction.
Hook activation required normal host trust/account access; an initially file-sandboxed Claude status check could not access its native account, so authenticated tests used the normal host runtime.
